title: 冰川徒步8人小团-The Glacier Hiking Dream Exploring
text: 冰川徒步8人小团-The Glacier Hiking Dream Exploring ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour 冰川徒步8人小团-The Glacier Hiking Dream Exploring 4 hours Easy 冰岛唯一中文冰川向导｜冰川徒步小团 冰岛索尔黑马冰川（Sólheimajökull）位于冰岛南岸，是冰岛第四大冰盖米尔达斯冰川（Mýrdalsjökull）最著名的冰舌之一，距离冰岛首都雷克雅未克仅2.5小时车程。 索尔黑马冰川完美的诠释了冰岛“冰与火之岛”称号的来源，由于周围火山的喷发，火山灰停留在冰川之上，或白或蓝的冰川与黑色的火山灰相互依存，构成了一幅完美的中国山水画。这也让索尔黑马冰川形成了与世无双的冰川形态，让你看到的冰川跟世界上其他的冰川都不一样。登上冰川后，我们可以看到更多的冰川形态，冰裂缝，冰洞，冰川融水等等，同时也可远观北大西洋。 无论老人和小孩，还是善于探险的年轻人，都会乐享其中。同时我们的专业户外向导不光有多年的带队经验，还是冰川摄影师！在带领您探索冰川的同时，也会为您拍下朋友圈九宫格哦！ 活动的见面地点在索尔黑马冰川的停车场，我们专业的向导会帮您穿戴好一切冰川探险的必须装备，然后共同前往冰川，活动总时长为4个小时左右。但是这4个小时并不是全程徒步，我们将会把冰川徒步以及拍照停留很好的结合在一起，让您在享受冰川美景的同时，也不会体力不支！ 我们的优势： 冰岛本土注册旅行公司，专注冰岛高端旅行，小团提供中英文双语服务。 我司向导均长期定居冰岛，一路为您讲解不为人知的当地故事，解答您一切有关冰岛的问题。 冰岛唯一可提供中文服务的专业冰川向导团队。 我们的承诺： 无任何强制小费或其他强制性购物消费，所有收费透明清晰。 拒绝特种兵，我们的向导和你一起探索景点，不只是打卡，我们专注的是美好的旅行体验。 What's included? 中英文专业认证冰川向导； 安全所需装备：安全锁，冰爪，头盔，登山杖（如需要）。 Exclusions 防水衣，防水裤； 零食； 停车费。 Please note 冰岛天气多变，为保证安全，此活动会根据天气调整行程。若因天气原因取消行程，费用将会全额退还。 参团人需身体健康无重大疾病（包括但不限于心脏病，哮喘等）。 以下装备需自备：高帮徒步鞋，防水衣裤，手套帽子等保暖配件。 见面地点可提供徒步鞋及防水衣物租赁，2000冰岛克朗（约100元人民币）/件。 What to bring 保暖的户外服装（建议参加活动每个小组背一个双肩背包）； 防风防水的外套和裤子； 高帮徒步鞋； 手套和帽子。 Magic Iceland Travel +354 7778011 info@magicicelandtravel.com Síðumúli 9, Reykjavík, 108, IS SUPPORT Terms & Conditions Contact QUICK LINKS Home Home Contact English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions FOLLOW US Share by: Powered by Bókun

title: Djúpivogur: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach Cruise Tour
text: Djúpivogur: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach Cruise Tour ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour View more Djúpivogur: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach Cruise Tour 6 hours and 30 minutes Easy Enjoy a family-friendly shore excursion from Djúpivogur Port to Iceland's stunning southeast coast, featuring Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, Diamond Beach, and scenic landscapes with a local guide and guaranteed return to your cruise. Experience some of Iceland’s most breathtaking natural wonders on this unforgettable cruise-tailored shore excursion from Djúpivogur Port. This scenic journey along Iceland’s spectacular southeast coast takes you to the world-famous Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, sparkling Diamond Beach, and dramatic mountain landscapes shaped by glaciers, volcanoes, and the powerful North Atlantic Ocean. Designed specifically for cruise ship passengers, this tour is carefully timed to match your ship’s schedule, ensuring a smooth and stress-free experience with guaranteed return to port no later than 1 hour before your ship’s departure. Your adventure begins with a scenic coastal drive through the remote and beautiful landscapes of East Iceland. Along the way, enjoy a stop at the striking Eystrahorn Mountain, famous for its dramatic jagged peaks rising above black sand beaches and wild coastal scenery. The highlight of the tour is the incredible Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, one of Iceland’s most iconic destinations. Here, enormous icebergs break away from Europe’s largest glacier and drift peacefully across the lagoon toward the ocean, creating an ever-changing landscape of ice, light, and reflections. Just across the road, you will visit Diamond Beach, where crystal-clear icebergs wash ashore on the black volcanic sand, creating one of Iceland’s most magical natural contrasts. Before returning to Djúpivogur Port, enjoy a scenic stop at Hvalnes Lighthouse, surrounded by dramatic mountains and rugged coastline views that perfectly capture the raw beauty of Icelandic nature. Throughout the tour, your local guide will share stories, local insights, and fascinating information about Iceland’s glaciers, geology, culture, and everyday life. With unforgettable scenery, comfortable transportation, and cruise-tailored timing, this shore excursion is the perfect way to experience the icy beauty of Iceland during your time ashore. What's included? Cruise-tailored shore excursion from Djúpivogur Port Professional local guide Transportation in a comfortable vehicle with free Wi-Fi on board Visit to Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon Visit to Diamond Beach Scenic stops at Eystrahorn Mountain and Hvalnes Lighthouse Guaranteed return to your cruise ship on time Small Icelandic local surprise Exclusions Food and drinks Personal expenses Please note This tour is specially tailored to cruise ship schedules and departure times may vary depending on your ship’s arrival and departure. Please follow the instructions provided in your ticket regarding meeting time and location at Djúpivogur Port. We guarantee return to the port no later than 1 hour before your ship’s departure. The tour includes short walks on uneven surfaces and natural terrain. Icelandic weather can change quickly, so we recommend dressing in warm, windproof, and waterproof layers. Comfortable walking shoes are strongly recommended. Food stops may vary depending on the day and tour timing. The order of stops may change due to weather, road, or operational conditions. Suitable for all ages and fitness levels comfortable with light walking. text: From Reykjavik: Golden Circle & Lagoon Full Day Small Group guided in Chinese冰岛黄金圈+可选小众温泉中文一日精品团 ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour View more From Reykjavik: Golden Circle & Lagoon Full Day Small Group guided in Chinese冰岛黄金圈+可选小众温泉中文一日精品团 10 hours Easy 在中文导游的带领下探索冰岛黄金圈体验冰岛温泉！一天内游览 Kerið 火山口、Geysir 地热区、Gullfoss 黄金瀑布、Brúarfoss 蓝色瀑布、 Þingvellir 国家公园，以及冰岛温泉，开启一段难忘的旅程。 探索冰岛著名的黄金圈，一日行程从雷克雅未克出发，全程中文导游陪伴！ 在这趟难忘的旅程中，您将探访瀑布、间歇泉、火山口以及冰岛最具历史意义的国家公园。 旅程首先来到 Þingvellir 国家公园 （联合国教科文组织世界遗产）。在这里您可以漫步于北美板块与欧亚板块之间的裂谷地带。 然后到访 Kerið 火山口 ，这里以鲜艳的红色火山岩坡和深蓝色火山湖而闻名，景色十分独特。 接着前往迷人的 Brúarfoss 瀑布 ，因其独特的湛蓝色水流而被称为“蓝色秘境瀑布”，是黄金圈路线上的一处隐藏宝藏。 随后会前往著名的 Geysir 地热区 ，这里的 Strokkur 间歇泉 每隔几分钟就会喷发一次，将滚烫的热水直冲天空，场面十分壮观。不远处就是气势磅礴的 Gullfoss 黄金瀑布 ，它是冰岛最壮丽、最具代表性的自然奇观之一。 最后来到冰岛 Laugarás Lagoon 新开小众温泉 ，给一天的行程画上一个享受又放松的句号。如果您选择不去温泉可以在温泉附近自由活动，稍作休息，等待回程。 在专业的中文导游陪同下，一天之内尽览冰岛最经典的自然与历史景观，体验冰岛温泉，收获一段难忘的冰岛之旅！ What's included? title: Glacier Hike Captured in Skaftafell
text: Glacier Hike Captured in Skaftafell ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour View more Glacier Hike Captured in Skaftafell 3 hours Easy Join us on Falljökull Glacier to explore an epic glacier hike while exploring some of the ice's most beautiful features! One of the most popular tours is glacier hiking photoshoot . Your guide will drive you to Falljökull Glacier via a super jeep to begin your adventure. text: Glacier Hike, South Coast Waterfalls & Black Sand Beach ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour View more Glacier Hike, South Coast Waterfalls & Black Sand Beach 11 hours Easy Embark on a remarkable day trip from Reykjavik to explore Iceland’s enchanting south coast. Delve into the magic of the Sólheimajökull glacier as you gear up for an exciting glacier hike, equipped with harnesses, crampons, ice picks, and helmets. Experience what it is like to stand on a glacier Embark on a remarkable day trip from Reykjavik to explore Iceland’s enchanting south coast. Delve into the magic of the Sólheimajökull glacier as you gear up for an exciting glacier hike, equipped with harnesses, crampons, ice picks, and helmets. Discover iconic attractions like stunning waterfalls and the world-renowned Reynisfjara black-sand beach. These natural wonders encapsulate the unique beauty of Iceland’s south coast, making this journey an unforgettable experience. Don't miss out on this captivating adventure! Itinerary Glacier Hike on Sólheimajökull Sólheimajökull, an outlet glacier of Mýrdalsjökull, Iceland’s fourth-largest glacier, graces the South Coast with its presence. Located just 158 kilometers (98 miles) from Reykjavík, it offers a unique opportunity to explore glacial features and gain insight into its formation. This icy realm is a living testament to the dynamic forces that shape Iceland’s ever-changing landscape. The Black Sand Beach Reynisfjara, a stunning black sand beach on the South Coast, showcases the raw power of the Atlantic Ocean. Its colossal waves crash upon the shore, creating an awe-inspiring spectacle. Basalt columns, resembling ancient sentinels, line the beach, while the enigmatic “Reynisdrangar” sea stacks emerge from the ocean’s depths, steeped in local folklore. This beach has earned its place among the world’s most beautiful non-tropical beaches. Skogafoss waterfall Skogafoss, one of Iceland’s classic waterfalls, stands as a magnificent testament to the power of nature. Soaring to a height of 65 meters and spanning 25 meters in width, it ranks among the country’s largest waterfalls. Local legend weaves tales of a hidden chest of gold behind the falls, a challenge that would require the strength and bravery of a Viking to pursue. Seljalandsfoss waterfalls Seljalandsfoss, another of Iceland’s classic waterfalls, offers a unique twist on the traditional waterfall experience. While not among the country’s largest falls, what sets Seljalandsfoss apart is the rare opportunity to walk behind the cascading water for most of the year. This immersive encounter transports you into a world of mist and magic, revealing a different perspective of nature’s beauty. What's included? Immerse yourself in the extraordinary experience of diving in the crystal-clear glacial waters of Silfra, where you can enjoy over 100 meters of visibility encompassing its breathtaking surroundings. Furthermore, you’ll have the unique opportunity to swim between two continents, providing an excellent view of the fissure that separates the European and American continental plates. The total diving duration is approximately 3 hours, including one dive and the chance to explore Silfra Hall, Silfra Cathedral, and Silfra Lagoon. Following your diving adventure, please return to Reykjavík Old Harbour to embark on the whale-watching tour, commencing at 14:00. During the cruise, you’re likely to encounter Minke whales, dolphins, porpoises, and possibly even Humpback whales! After an exhilarating exploration of these magnificent marine creatures and seabirds in Faxaflói Bay, we’ll return to the harbor around 17:00, where our shuttle bus will take you back to your hotel. To engage in diving at Silfra, there are specific requirements and criteria that participants must meet: Certification or Experience: Participants must either hold a valid certification as a dry suit diver or provide evidence of at least 10 logged dry suit dives within the past two years. This proof should be in the form of a written confirmation from an instructor affiliated with a globally recognized diving organization. Medical Statement : All diving participants are required to carefully review and sign a “Diving Silfra Medical Statement.” If necessary, individuals must follow any instructions provided for obtaining medical clearance from a doctor for the tour. Age and Height/Weight Criteria: Participants must be at least 18 years old (17 with parental permission) and no older than 65 years. They should have a height of at least 150 cm and weigh a minimum of 45 kg, but not exceed 120 kg. Additionally, they should be physically fit. Diver Certification: Participants must possess certification as a diver at the level of PADI Open Water or an equivalent certification. Proof of this certification should be brought along. Comfort with Dry Suit: Be prepared to wear a sometimes snug and constricting dry suit. Prior dry suit diving experience is recommended to ensure comfort. Swimming Abilities: Participants should feel comfortable in the water and possess the ability to swim. These requirements are in place to ensure the safety and preparedness of all participants in order to fully enjoy and benefit from the Silfra diving experience. This 14-hour journey takes you across 380 km (236 miles) , showcasing some of Iceland’s most iconic landscapes shaped by glaciers, volcanoes and the ocean. What will you see on the Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon tour? Along the way, you will explore a range of natural highlights along Iceland’s coastline. Seljalandsfoss waterfall Stjórnarfoss waterfall Vík village Visit coastal landscapes where waterfalls, beaches and cliffs meet , including stops at lesser-known locations such as Stjórnarfoss waterfall . If you prefer a more intimate experience, you can also explore our South Coast small group tour . What is the Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon and Diamond Beach like? Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon is formed by an outlet glacier from Vatnajökull , Europe’s largest ice cap, creating a landscape of drifting icebergs. At nearby Diamond Beach, blocks of ice rest on black sand, forming a striking contrast between ice and volcanic shoreline. Created in the 1970s, this glacial lagoon has become a symbol of Iceland’s ever-changing nature , shaped by the forces of ice and time. This full-day tour combines glacier landscapes, coastal scenery and iconic landmarks, offering a comprehensive journey through South Iceland.
